title: Internal Hom from a finite free sheaf is exact
statement: Let $(U,\mathcal O_U)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $E$ be an $\mathcal O_U$-module equipped with an isomorphism $E\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$ for some integer $r\geq0$, and let $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $0\to\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_U}(E,A)\to\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_U}(E,B)\to\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_U}(E,C)\to0$ is exact; under the chosen isomorphism $E\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$, each internal Hom is canonically identified with the corresponding direct sum $A^{\oplus r}$, $B^{\oplus r}$, or $C^{\oplus r}$.
